overview_description.description: AdKraft.ai is a full-stack, AI-native creative platform for video advertising. It spans strategy, production, and intelligence in one workflow: turn a creative brief into campaign themes, ad ideas, storylines, storyboards, characters, and a finished multi-scene film; reframe, upscale, and localize to 160+ languages; and run competitor reverse-engineering, ad-impact prediction, and brand perception. Free HD Quick Ads with no card; paid plans add the full campaign builder and intelligence suite.
